title: Exam Readiness v2 — Extended Prediction & Intervention
description: Extends the Exam Readiness MVP with three prediction engines (forgetting risk, mastery stability, projected exam score), an intervention planner, tutor context injection, and recommendation engine integration — converting readiness data into actionable academic forecasts.

userStories.title: Risk Prediction Models: Forgetting Risk + Mastery Stability
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ForgettingRiskPredictor and MasteryStabilityPredictor that consume LearnerSnapshot data and compute per-topic forgetting probability and stability scores, so the system can predict which topics are at risk of regression.
acceptanceCriteria: ForgettingRisk model at readiness/models/forgetting_risk.py: topic (str), forgetting_risk (float 0-1), days_overdue (int), ease_factor (float), review_count (int), contributing_factors (list[str])
StabilityScore model at readiness/models/mastery_stability.py: topic (str), stability_score (float 0-1), stability_band (str: Stable/Moderate/Volatile)
Both models are Pydantic BaseModel classes
ForgettingRiskPredictor.predict_forgetting(snapshot) returns dict[str, ForgettingRisk]
For topics with review data: forgetting_risk = min(days_overdue/30, 1.0) * (2.5-ease_factor)/1.2 * max(0, 1-review_count*0.1) * (1-mastery_score/100*0.5), clamped [0.01, 0.99]
For topics without review data: forgetting_risk = max(0.15, 1.0 - mastery_score/100 * 0.7), clamped [0.01, 0.99]
MasteryStabilityPredictor.predict_stability(snapshot) returns dict[str, StabilityScore]
Stability = mastery_score/100*0.4 + (1-ability_uncertainty/3.0)*0.3 + min(review_count/10, 1.0)*0.2 + recovery_progress*0.1, clamped [0.0, 1.0]
Stability band: >=0.7='Stable', >=0.4='Moderate', else='Volatile'
Empty state: empty dict when no mastery data
Review count defaults to 0 when no matching review schedule found
Recovery progress defaults to 0.0 when no matching recovery plan
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Uses existing snapshot fields (due_reviews, mastery_by_topic, ability_by_topic, active_recovery_plans) — no new loaders

userStories.title: Projected Exam Score & Intervention Planner
userStories.description: As a developer, I want ProjectedScoreCalculator and InterventionPlanner that compute a blended projected exam score, prediction confidence, and prioritized intervention list — extending ExamReadinessProfile with actionable guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Intervention model at readiness/models/intervention.py: topic (str), priority (float 0-1), action_type (str), estimated_impact (float 0-100), reason (str)
ExamReadinessProfile gains: confidence_score (float 0.0-1.0), projected_exam_score (float 0-100), recommended_interventions (list[Intervention])
Default values when no mastery data: confidence_score=0.5, projected_exam_score=0.0, recommended_interventions=[]
ProjectedScoreCalculator.calculate(readiness_profile, forgetting_risks, stabilities, snapshot) returns (projected_exam_score, confidence_score)
Projected score = readiness * 0.40 + avg(ability_scores)*100*0.25 + avg(stability_scores)*100*0.20 + (1-avg(forgetting_risks))*100*0.15, clamped 0-100
Confidence score = 1.0 - 0.1*(topics_with_attempts_lt_3) - 0.1*(topics_with_high_uncertainty) - 0.1*(stale_snapshot), clamped [0.10, 1.00]
Stale snapshot = generated_at older than 7 days from now
InterventionPlanner.plan(snapshot, readiness_profile, forgetting_risks, stabilities) returns list[Intervention] sorted by priority descending
Generates interventions for: risk topics (action=REVISE_MISCONCEPTION if misconception present, else REVIEW_TOPIC), high forgetting >0.6 (REVIEW_TOPIC), low stability <0.4 (REVIEW_TOPIC)
Priority = (1-readiness_score/100)*0.5 + forgetting_risk*0.3 + (1-stability_score)*0.2
Estimated impact = max(0, 100 - readiness_score) * (confidence_score * 0.5 + 0.5)
ReadinessService.get_readiness() integrates all new predictors, returns enhanced ExamReadinessProfile
GET /intelligence/readiness/{user_id} response includes all new fields
Empty state: returns defaults with empty interventions list
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on ER-005 for forgetting risk and stability inputs

userStories.title: Dashboard v2 — ExamReadinessCard Extended
userStories.description: As a student, I want the ExamReadinessCard to show my projected exam score, forgetting risk levels per topic, and recommended interventions, so I have actionable next steps alongside my readiness overview.
acceptanceCriteria: ExamReadinessCard displays projected_exam_score as a secondary percentage next to overall_readiness
Shows forgetting_risk per topic in the risk topics section as a colored progress bar (red >0.6, yellow 0.3-0.6, green <0.3)
Shows intervention list below risk topics with action_type badge, estimated_impact, and reason text
TypeScript interfaces updated: ForgettingRisk, StabilityScore, Intervention
Loading skeleton accounts for new data fields
Error state with retry button preserves all existing behavior
Empty state displays for missing enhancement data without breaking existing readiness display
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using Playwright browser tools
userStories.notes: Depends on ER-006 for data; API already returns all fields

userStories.title: Tutor Integration — Readiness Context Injection
userStories.description: As a student, I want the tutor to be aware of my exam readiness and risk topics, so it can prioritise high-risk subject areas during tutoring.
acceptanceCriteria: LearnerProfileBuilder._format_profile_block() accepts optional readiness_context param (dict with risk_topics list)
When readiness_context is provided and topic is in risk_topics: appends '## Exam Readiness' section with warning text
AdaptiveStrategySelector.select() returns EXAM_PREPARATION strategy when current_topic matches a readiness risk topic
TutorContextAdapter.build() computes readiness via ReadinessService and passes to profile builder and strategy selector
Existing profile_block unchanged when readiness_context is None or empty risk_topics
Existing strategy selection unchanged when no readiness risk match
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on ER-005 data being available through ReadinessService

userStories.title: Recommendation Engine Integration — Readiness Boost Rule
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the recommendation engine to factor exam readiness into priority scoring, so at-risk topics are surfaced in the recommendation feed.
acceptanceCriteria: New rule file at recommendation/rules/readiness_rules.py with async generator readiness_rules(snapshot: LearnerSnapshot) taking readiness_profile context
Generates REVIEW_TOPIC recommendations for each risk topic from readiness_profile
Priority raw score = (100 - readiness_score) / 100 * 40 (maps 0-40 range)
Reason explains the exam risk context
Rule registered in recommendation/rules/__init__.py
Rule added to RULE_GENERATORS list in recommendation/services/engine.py
RecommendationEngine.fetch_readiness_on_miss() calls ReadinessService when readiness_rules generator is active
Continue Learning feed prioritization by readiness deferred — blocked on PR #24 (ralph/continue-learning-proactive-guidance) merge
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Recommendation rule is independent; CL integration deferred until PR #24 merges
